Challenge Me - Math Workout.name: Challenge Me: Math Workout
Challenge Me - Math Workout.summary: A brain training game for the Nintendo DS.

Fushigi Yuugi DS.name: Fushigi Yuugi DS
Fushigi Yuugi DS.summary: A compilation of Idea Factory's two visual novel tie-ins to the popular manga franchise Fushigi Yuugi, ported to the Nintendo DS.

Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna I.name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna Volume I: Tatari
Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna I.summary: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna Volume I: Tatari is the first installment in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna, which includes the second to fourth arcs ported from Matsuri and a brand new extra arc from the first Advanced Story saga called Someutsushi-hen.

Plop en de Pinguin.name: Plop and the Penguin
Plop en de Pinguin.summary: Go with Plop and his friends to the south pole for an exciting adventure. Help the Penguin Pinki that is being chased by criminals. Play 10 funny gnome games and return Pinki to the south pole.

Timmy Time.name: Timmy Time
Timmy Time.summary: Join in the fun with Timmy, Osbourne, Mittens and friends and play 14 entertaining games and activities including: DJ Timmy, Go Kart Timmy, Timmy Plays Catch and many more!.
